title: Unique Crisp American Tomato Wrap
description: A nutty and crisp American dish featuring chopped tomatoes, ssam-wrap, and diabetic-friendly ingredients, perfect for the monsoon season
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium heat to 350 degrees Fahrenheit
Add the olive oil and saute the chopped almonds until lightly toasted
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they start to soften
Add the ssam-wrap sauce and stir to combine
Warm the whole wheat tortilla in the microwave for 20 seconds
Assemble the wrap by spreading the tomato mixture down the center of the tortilla
Top with shredded lettuce, sliced cucumber, and grilled chicken breast
Fold the bottom half of the tortilla up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the wrap to enclose
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
